editorial: Imagine the most chaotic family dinner of your life, then add a botched heist and a terrifying secret. You are dropped into a pressure cooker of Irish familial dysfunction where desperation transforms a holiday tradition into a blood-soaked game of cat and mouse. Dallan Shovlin masterfully balances the belly laughs of a failing clan with the sudden, sharp jolts of a psychological thriller. You will find yourself rooting for the wrong people until the moment the rug is pulled from under you. It is a lean, mean ride designed for anyone who loves their dark comedy served with a side of genuine dread.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of high-stakes family dysfunction and twist-driven narratives.
